gloss: to grow fond of; to become attached to

definitions.gloss: to grow fond of; to become attached to; to develop affection for
definitions.explanation: To gradually develop feelings of attachment or fondness toward something or someone through familiarity and use over time.

examples.japanese: この{靴|くつ}には{愛着|あいちゃく}が{湧|わ}いてきた。
examples.english: I've grown fond of these shoes.

examples.japanese: {使|つか}い{続|つづ}けるうちに{道具|どうぐ}に{愛着|あいちゃく}が{湧|わ}く。
examples.english: You become attached to a tool as you keep using it.

examples.japanese: {最初|さいしょ}は{興味|きょうみ}がなかったが、{住|す}んでいるうちにこの{町|まち}に{愛着|あいちゃく}が{湧|わ}いてきた。
examples.english: At first I wasn't interested, but as I lived here I grew fond of this town.

notes:
USAGE:
The noun {愛着|あいちゃく} means attachment or affection. Combined with {湧|わ}く (to well up, to spring forth), it expresses the gradual, natural development of fondness. Can be used for objects, places, people, and activities.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {愛着|あいちゃく}が{湧|わ}く (to grow fond of)
- {愛着|あいちゃく}のある (having affection for)
- {愛着|あいちゃく}を{持|も}つ (to have attachment to)
- {愛着|あいちゃく}を{感|かん}じる (to feel attachment)

SIMILAR EXPRESSIONS:
- {親|した}しみが{湧|わ}く: to feel familiarity/warmth — more about feeling comfortable with someone
- {愛着|あいちゃく}が{湧|わ}く: to become attached — deeper emotional bond, often with objects or places
